description: Normalization v2 parity fixtures (AQ-02 P2a). scripts/tests/test_language_metrics.py and Tests/VocelloCoreTests/WordErrorRateTests.swift both score every case and must reproduce `expected` exactly. `primaryErrors` is the gated edit count: the segmentation-aware word distance, or the character edits for Chinese, Japanese and Korean. `pythonDiagnostics` never gate and are Python-only. A `P2b` case needs a package step (its `slot` in language_metrics.NORMALIZATION_EXTENSION_SLOTS); `expected` pins today's score and `expectedAfterP2b` what the step will change. Cases whose id starts with `sweep-` are generated by `python3 scripts/tests/test_language_metrics.py --write-sweep-cases`: every code point of its SWEEP_BLOCKS, 64 to a case, in the folded (English), compatibility (Japanese) and Hangul (Korean) profiles, against its NFD spelling, so Swift's stdlib and Foundation Unicode data answer to Python's code point by code point.
